title: Fit a straight line
prompt: Read lines from standard input, each holding a point `X Y`: two decimal numbers separated by a single space (an optional minus sign, digits, and optionally a `.` followed by digits). Blank lines are skipped; any other line prints `line N: bad point` (N counts the lines from 1) and is ignored. Fit the least-squares line y = a*x + b through the points: with n points, a = (n*Sxy - Sx*Sy) / (n*Sxx - Sx*Sx) and b = (Sy - a*Sx) / n, where Sx, Sy, Sxy and Sxx are the sums of x, y, x*y and x*x over the points, added in input order. Print `n=N slope=A intercept=B`, with A and B written with exactly 4 digits after the decimal point, rounded to the nearest. When there are fewer than two points, or when n*Sxx - Sx*Sx is 0 (all x equal), print `n=N undefined`. Every answer in the tests is well away from a rounding tie.

cases.name: example
cases.expected_output:
line 4: bad point
n=5 slope=1.9700 intercept=0.0900
